overview: Edge Application Latency Visibility addresses source evidence is scattered across documents and transaction systems, leading to repeated checks and incomplete case files in telecommunications operations. The first proof of value uses edge node telemetry, application traces and network routes. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is p95 latency at edge user site, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.
kpi: p95 latency at edge user site

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: edge node telemetry, application traces and network routes; define p95 latency at edge user site and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from Network Operations Director / Telco Product VP.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including run golden documents and exceptions against the system of record.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
